scenario.task:
I want to request a warranty replacement for my iPhone because the screen is flickering and has no physical damage

User Guide: The user explains their iPhone screen is flickering. They will verify their identity, confirm there is no physical or water damage, and agree to the warranty replacement terms If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
